description: Applies the stage-one candidate band (FORMULATION.md section 0) to the flattened catalog frame, returning survivors plus a per-reason rejection tally so the funnel stays auditable (ARCHITECTURE.md limitation 7, ADR-004).
signature: def coarse_filter(catalog: pd.DataFrame, criteria: CoarseFilterCriteria) -> FunnelResult
docstring:
Apply the coarse filter band.

Args:
    catalog: Output of build_catalog_frame.
    criteria: The band to apply (config.CoarseFilterCriteria), including publisher_blocklist.

Returns:
    FunnelResult(candidates=<survivors>, total_input=len(catalog), rejected_by_reason=<dict>, criteria=criteria).

Rejection order (a row is counted under the FIRST reason it fails, so tallies are mutually exclusive and sum to total excluded): duplicate_appid (already resolved upstream in build_catalog_frame, tallied here only if a caller passes a pre-deduplicated frame with a duplicate marker) -> missing_required_field (no appid, no publisher/developer at all) -> review_count_below_floor -> review_count_above_ceiling (only when criteria.max_review_count is not None) -> release_date_outside_window (note: build_catalog_frame does not itself carry release_date -- release_date is only available after appdetails is fetched; the coarse filter's review-count/price/free-to-play checks run against SteamSpy bulk fields only, and the release-date-window check is DEFERRED to a second, cheap pass after appdetails is fetched, since SteamSpy's bulk payload does not reliably carry a parseable release date -- see the flagged inconsistency below) -> free_to_play_excluded (only when criteria.include_free_to_play is False) -> price_above_max -> publisher_blocklisted (case-insensitive substring match of any criteria.publisher_blocklist entry against the row's publisher field).

INCONSISTENCY FLAGGED TO USER: 02_acquisition.module_spec.json's coarse_filter_contract.rejection_reasons list includes 'release_date_outside_window' as a stage-one (SteamSpy-bulk-stage) rejection reason, but SteamSpy's bulk 'all' payload does not include a reliable release date field (release dates come from Steam's appdetails, fetched only for survivors, per ADR-004's two-stage funnel). This spec resolves the discrepancy by treating the release-date-window check as a second, still-'coarse' filtering pass applied to appdetails results before enrichment proper begins -- but 02_acquisition.module_spec.json does not clearly assign this second pass to any named function. Needs an explicit decision: either (a) coarse_filter is re-invoked a second time after fetch_app_details with a reduced criteria set, or (b) the release-date check moves into enrichment's row-dropping logic instead of acquisition's rejected_by_reason tally. This spec assumes (a) for now. Also: 02_acquisition.module_spec.json's coarse_filter_contract.rejection_reasons list is missing 'publisher_blocklisted' entirely (see config.CoarseFilterCriteria's flagged inconsistency) -- added here.
preconditions: catalog has the columns produced by build_catalog_frame
criteria.publisher_blocklist entries are already-trimmed, non-empty strings
postconditions: Every row in candidates satisfies every criterion in criteria simultaneously

rejected_by_reason contains an entry (possibly 0) for every reason in the acquisition module's coarse_filter_contract.rejection_reasons list plus 'publisher_blocklisted', even if some reasons rejected zero rows, so the funnel report always has a stable key set

edge_cases.input: min_review_count boundary: a row with review_count exactly equal to criteria.min_review_count
edge_cases.expected_behavior: included (inclusive lower bound), per the module's own testing requirement 'boundary behaviour is inclusive/exclusive exactly as specified at min and max review count' -- floor is inclusive (>=)
no row is ever rejected for review_count_above_ceiling; that tally key is present with value 0

row is not rejected for being free-to-play; it proceeds to the publisher-blocklist and price checks normally (price_above_max with max_price_usd set would need special-casing: a free title's price 0 never exceeds any positive max_price_usd, so it is never rejected for price either)

edge_cases.input: publisher field is empty string or NaN
edge_cases.expected_behavior: not matched against any blocklist entry (an empty string is never treated as 'contains' any non-empty blocklist substring) and not rejected as missing_required_field on its own (publisher can legitimately be unset for some SteamSpy entries) -- only appid missing triggers missing_required_field
rejected as publisher_blocklisted via case-insensitive substring match against the blocklist entry 'Ubisoft'
returns FunnelResult(candidates=<empty frame>, total_input=0, rejected_by_reason=<all zeros>, criteria=criteria)

unit_tests.name: test_tallies_each_rejection_reason_on_synthetic_catalog
unit_tests.description: A synthetic catalog with one row purpose-built to fail each reason (and one clean survivor) produces the expected per-reason counts summing correctly with the survivor.
unit_tests.expected: each reason count == 1, candidates has exactly 1 row

unit_tests.name: test_min_review_count_boundary_inclusive
unit_tests.description: A row with review_count == min_review_count is kept; review_count == min_review_count - 1 is rejected.
unit_tests.expected: boundary row kept, one-below row rejected as review_count_below_floor

unit_tests.name: test_no_ceiling_never_rejects
unit_tests.description: With max_review_count=None, a row with review_count=10_000_000 is kept.

unit_tests.name: test_publisher_blocklist_case_insensitive_substring
unit_tests.description: publisher='UBISOFT ENTERTAINMENT' is rejected when blocklist contains 'Ubisoft'.

unit_tests.name: test_free_to_play_kept_when_included
unit_tests.description: A price_usd=0 row with include_free_to_play=True is not rejected as free_to_play_excluded.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_catalog_returns_empty_result
unit_tests.description: An empty input frame returns an empty FunnelResult with all-zero tallies.
